launch.question: Is Wordhabit available now?
launch.answer: Yes. Wordhabit is available now on Google Play and the App Store.

devices.question: Will it work on my phone?
devices.answer: Yes. Wordhabit works on Android and iPhone.

free.question: Is Wordhabit really free?
free.answer: Yes. The word of the day, flashcards and mastery are free forever. Pro is optional and adds extra quiz modes, several languages at once and streak repair.

dictionary.question: How is this different from a dictionary app?
dictionary.answer: Dictionaries are for lookups. Wordhabit is for retention: spaced review, real examples and quizzes move a word from “I have seen that” to “I use that”.

duration.question: How long is a daily session?
duration.answer: About five minutes: discover the word, practice with cards, prove it in a short quiz. The review comes back days later, right before you would forget.

a.description: Wordhabit teaches one word a day, deeply. Discover it, practice it, master it, review it later: one small journey a day, and the word is yours.

b.description: One word with your coffee. Three small steps, a streak that keeps you honest, and tomorrow a new word is waiting.

c.description: Spaced review brings each word back just before you would forget it, until it moves from seen-it to use-it.
